verdict.rationale: Veo's own documentation index lists 'camera motion controls' for configuring text-to-video generation, and a community comment credits Google's tools with prompting motion and direction. However, the evidence is a single index-level mention, with no detail on which moves are supported or how reliably they are followed. missing for 10: documentation of specific moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static), the syntax or parameters for setting them, and hands-on evidence that requested camera moves are actually followed.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks

citations.quote: camera motion controls, and lighting tokens for configuring text-to-video generation within the Veo framework
The biggest differentiator is editing tools (prompting motion, direction, cuts, audio).
